allowed.reason: Avalonia's protocol for its design-time previewer, referenced by Avalonia.Controls. Avalonia.Controls uses only its message types and connection interface; the networking is in BsonTcpTransport and TcpTransportBase, which only the previewer creates, and the previewer's own support assembly isn't shipped (PrivacyRemovedFromOutput). Our code is banned from the whole namespace (BannedSymbols.txt).
